environment.description: Same ARM gateway binary deployed on hardened Yocto 4.0 (kirkstone) image. The process runs under a systemd unit with MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes and a custom seccomp-bpf profile (allowlist: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap with PROT_EXEC denied, brk, ioctl, sendto, recvfrom, connect, socket - no mprotect, no execve, no clone). PostgreSQL 14 on db.internal configured with row-level security policy on device_telemetry: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON device_telemetry USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')); ALTER TABLE device_telemetry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; The device_writer_* roles have the session variable app.current_tenant set via a pg_hba.conf connection option mapped from the role suffix. Additionally, the kernel is compiled with CONFIG_STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG=y and the binary is rebuilt with the BSP's default flags which now include -fstack-protector-strong -pie -fPIE, and kernel.randomize_va_space=2 is set in sysctl.
